scientific_integrity: A proved algebraic classification of the completed two-stage Gauss-Legendre Padé diffusion map on weighted undirected connected three-vertex Laplacians. All quantifiers and boundary equalities appear in RESULT.md. Exact rational finite verification independently reconstructs test matrices; no extrapolation from finite tests is used.
scientific_limitations: Only connected weighted undirected three-vertex networks and nonnegative real timesteps; no stagewise SSP, arbitrary nonreversible systems, higher-dimensional graphs, or independent external validation. Equivalent historical formulations might exist in unindexed mathematical literature.
title: Sharp all-step positivity and a weight-dominance cutoff for three-site Gauss diffusion
